thread:
raj: Heads-up — seeing a cluster of preemptions hitting the us-west dedicated pool for slice-svc. Lots of requests getting routed to eu-west fallback; latencies up ~220ms and egress $ spike. Anyone digging in? :eyes:
sophia: I saw the alert. telemetry shows a sudden GPU mem pressure on nodes with tag `dedicated-usw-2`. Suspect noisy neighbor (large-batch fine-tuning jobs) ramped up around 12:03 UTC.
emma: Can we throttle or soft-evict the offending tenants? We have `slice-qos` tags that should prefer preemptible spill, but seems misrouted.
raj: Dumped allocation events:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --selector=pool=dedicated-usw-2
# several large pods with annotations: workload.kind=training, batch.size=8192
```
raj: Also seeing many fallback routes hit `route:eu-west-fallback` in the proxy logs.
infra-bot: [ALERT] preemptions: 73 in last 5m on pool dedicated-usw-2 (metric: gpu.mem.used/total > 0.94) — ticket INC-3421 created.
mike: Quick mitigation: reduce pool admission by setting `pool.max_inflight` to 80% and lower `route_weight` for kantoor-ml tenants to 0.2. That should push heavy jobs to preemptible groups. I'll push the config in a sec.
sophia: If we throttle admission, ensure we don't bump committed customers. Use `tenant_tag=dedicated-committed` to exempt. Also enable KV cache sticky routing for active chats to reduce cross-region fallback.
emma: For the longer term, we should mark big-batch jobs with `batch:high` and route them to a physical isolation pool. Ops: can we reserve 2 nodes for batch-silo in usw?
raj: Agreed on batch-silo. For now mike, go ahead with soft admission tweak. After that, let's run a probe to verify fallback rate drops.
mike: Pushed `pool.max_inflight=0.8` and `route_weight.kantoor-ml=0.2` at 1768805145 — watching metrics.
infra-bot: [INFO] routing-update applied by mike at 1768805145.
sophia: Metric check at 1768805250: fallback rate ↓ from 12% -> 2.5%, p90 latency down ~180ms. Egress cost burn rate still elevated but trending down.
raj: Good. Create a small postmortem and schedule batch-silo rollout for next sprint. Add cost estimate for reserving nodes vs fallback egress.
emma: I started a doc: https://redwood.internal/sops/batch-silo-proposal — will invite infra and product.
mike: Will follow up with tenant owners to throttle their jobs. :thumbsup:
raj: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread open until we verify stable for 30m.
